review.reviewer: OpenAI Codex (GPT-6), primary agent /root; separate completion challenge following retained full assessment review
review.notes: Completed a distinct same-agent evidence review after drafting all 240 questions; this is not an independent review. Confirmed 15 briefs and counterevidence sections, 240 unique individually rationaled entries, 99 source records and valid source references. Rechecked incumbent and cutoff; separated enacted 2026 environmental and trade laws from proposals, old regulations and IMF recommendations. Replaced an unusable Pentagon report link with specific documented carrier commissioning, military drills and a jury conviction. Added direct local evidence for random alcohol screening, multilingual migrant-community signage and government-office religious-symbol inspections. Narrowed migrant-cultural claims instead of treating domestic ethnic-unity policies as migrant policy. Kept military pre-emption, per-attack human approval, healthy enhancement and trait-specific causal rankings unresolved where the sources do not establish them. Reviewed the five supported mixed responses on each of Innovation/Caution and Central/Local individually; they record implemented competing priorities or divided responsibilities, not missing evidence. Final validation on 2026-10-04 reports only the 33 deliberate unknown-answer entries (66 paired error messages), two neutral-count review warnings, and no neighbours because the assessment remains incomplete. No archive, generation, build or similarity clearance claimed. Flag File page, public-domain status and local 960x640 PNG were verified, with visual inspection; file size 6013 bytes. Independent parent review remains required, especially regional-to-national inference, the Culture/Nature-16 wage explanation, education about religion versus nonconfessional schooling, and general military superiority versus specific capability investment. The draft is not archive-ready; explicit question-level gaps are retained. Separate completion challenge 2026-10-05: checked all new estimates against exact questions and prior withdrawal reasons. Revised Immigration 8 to moderate disagreement after rereading the economically prioritised permanent-residence categories; restrictions alone do not establish housing pressure overriding gains. Retained benefit access as provisional because the text’s general equal-rights principle and insurance/housing-fund provisions do not directly specify noncontributory welfare. Reread the BCI ethics guidance, keeping noninvasive enhancement, restorative implants and healthy cognitive implants distinct. AI weapons remains a substantive conditional balance of development and human control. Reclassified the wage-gap extrapolation explicitly as an educated assumption; equality policy is not a measured productivity decomposition. Checked regional migrant integration as regional evidence, not nationwide adult mandate. Reviewed neutral-count axes against implemented sectoral balances, shared/local responsibilities and clinical interaction models; uncertainty alone did not justify Neutral. Earlier full review retained; this is a same-agent completion pass, not an independent human or second-agent review.
